Name: Luny's Swamp Background
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/2mjbfye.png[/img]﻿
Is your farm dark and mysterious, but your character background is all sunshine and clear skies? Well no more![/center][center]
This mod is a simple replacement for the character background that shows in the inventory, character customization, Fashion Sense, and
just about anything else that shows a preview of your character. I made this pretty quickly using a mashup of existing textures. The grass
base is a recolor of the vanilla background grass, the tree is from Aimon's tilesheets that was used in the swamp farm I commissioned,
and the background is a screenshot of said farm. Then I added in some fog effects for extra swampy goodness.

I did get permission from Aimon to share this mod since the tree is from their tilesheets.


UI shown in screenshots is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17323]Lavender Dreams UI Recolor.[/url]﻿


[b][color=#d5a6bd][size=4]UPDATE[/size][/color][/b]:
The new version uses Content Patcher and should work with any UI mod without replacing files. The info below is crossed out because it refers to the old replacement version. I'm leaving the text here and the files available in the archive in case anyone wants the replacements, but the CP version should work best.



[s]There are separate install files to hopefully match the UI mod you use.
ONLY INSTALL ONE.
Aside from vanilla, the files are replacements. Meaning they will replace the background image files in the UI mod.[/s]
[s]
For additional UI mods, feel free to leave a comment requesting a particular UI match. A link to the UI is very appreciated!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wvlMKlE.png[/img][b]﻿
Extract the file and move the folder to your StardewValley/Mods folder. Done![/b][s]


Vanilla - Install like any other Content Patcher mod. Just unzip and drop the folder into StardewValley/mods. You're good to go!

Matching modded UI - Unzip the file and drop the folder into StardewValley/mods. When asked if you want to replace files, choose yes.
The modded UI versions have folders that will match and merge with the UI mod's folders.

You can also mix and match with other UI mods if you don't mind the frame being a different color, but this will require copying the image files of the backgrounds from the version you want, then pasting them directly into the UI mod's folder that contains it's version of the backgrounds. [/s]
